newsitem.title: USA: Lax study of NW transmission blamed for Aug outage.
newsitem.headline: Lax study of NW transmission blamed for Aug outage.

text.p: A report on a major Aug 10 power outage in the U.S. West cited inadequate planning as a key factor hampering Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) transmission operators from moving to avert the blackout.
The outage left some 7.5 million customers across the West without electricity, some of them for up to six hours.

While the report did not cite Bonneville by name, the Western Systems Coordinating Council (WSCC) said the system was "unknowingly being operated in a manner" not in compliance with WSCC reliability criteria.
